extraction.underlying_driver: the benefit change was disclosed only through an account statement, which the customer considers misleading since statements are meant for financial details, not to hide changes to card benefits

topics.topic_label: benefit change hidden in statement, no clear notice
topics.issue_statement: The customer had to pay out of pocket for a card benefit that had changed, saying the change was only disclosed in fine print on an account statement rather than through a clear notification.
topics.driver: no clear notification of a benefit change; it was allegedly disclosed only via a statement, which the customer says is meant for financial details, not benefit changes

evidence.quote: I had to pay out of pocket for a benefit that was supposed to be included in my credit card.
evidence.speaker: narrative

evidence.quote: A bank agent mentioned that this change was communicated through an account statement, but this is misleading since account statements are meant for financial details and payment deadlines, not to hide changes to card benefits in fine print.
evidence.speaker: narrative

extraction.summary: A credit card benefit was quietly discontinued with the change reportedly disclosed only in fine print on a statement, leaving the customer to pay out of pocket and requesting a refund.

contact_reasons.specific_reason: $200.00 sign-up bonus denied on the claim the promotion didn't exist at signup, despite meeting the spend requirement

extraction.stated_reason: opened a Chase Freedom Unlimited card for an advertised $200.00 bonus after $500.00 spend, met the requirement, but was told the promotion didn't exist at the t
extraction.underlying_driver: the representative and supervisor both denied the promotion existed on the signup date despite the customer applying specifically because of that advertised offer

topics.topic_label: sign-up bonus denied as never having existed
topics.issue_statement: After meeting the $500.00 spend requirement for an advertised $200.00 sign-up bonus, the representative and supervisor both claimed the promotion wasn't active on the day the card was opened.
topics.driver: $200.00 sign-up bonus denied on the claim the promotion didn't exist at signup, despite it being the reason the customer applied that day

evidence.quote: The rep talked to the supervisor and they both claimed that they didnt have it at that time.
evidence.speaker: narrative

evidence.quote: I wouldnt have opened this Chase Freedom Unlimited if they didnt have the bonus offer, but they did have that offer that same day I applied and got approved XX/XX/year>.
evidence.speaker: narrative

extraction.summary: A $200.00 sign-up bonus was denied on the claim that the promotion didn't exist on the day the card was opened, despite it being the reason the customer applied.
